setup_man_role: register the man role and man_url_regex config value with a Sphinx app
create_man_link_node: create a docutils reference node linking to a man page URL using make_link_node
parse_man_reference: parse a man page reference like socket(2) using the man_role regex pattern
customize_man_url_regex: configure a custom man_url_regex template with num and topic placeholders in Sphinx config
review_man_role: review the man_role function to understand how it parses man page references and creates link nodes
